help.title: About marketplace settings
help.overview: Whether your services show on the portal, and which currency they use. One page for the whole company: a change applies from the moment you save.

sections.title: Marketplace
items: List on the portal: when on, your services also show in the portal's services section, where clients who don't know your website can find you. Your own website shows them either way.
Currency: used for a listing, package or add-on you price without choosing a currency, and for the budget when a client posts a job on your own website.

sections.title: What we provide
items: Sections you work in: the top-level service sections (for example Home Services or Legal Services). Your service form's category picker then offers only the categories in them, so you find yours faster.
Empty means every category is offered. The service categories themselves are one list for the whole platform; if a service is missing, request it on the Listing categories page.

sections.title: Portal jobs
sections.body: Shown only to the company that runs the portal.
items: Providers per job: how many providers hear about each new job. Empty means 10.
Open jobs per client: how many open jobs one client may have at a time. Empty means 5.
